One self-contained package, `research/w3-stages-restore/` (#312's package with one more native transcript stage), with its own workflow; branched from `main`, no existing file changed.

**Full replay: PASS** (`verify.py --output`, ~12 minutes locally): both prerequisite source verifiers, #304's supplier admission, #312's three stages, the restoration stage, recompaction, legality, all global and compact F₂ columns, the endpoint-aware bank allocation, 23,870 changed charts, geometry admission, exact price (nine ordinary levels, two engines, 47 strict constraints), finite invoice, complex guard and `finish.py`; prints `PASS conditional kappa = 151024082262820774685631/200000000000000000000000000`.

## Change

**438 early restorations after #312's reorder stage** — the stage #312 reports as blocked ("they would need final-frame changes that #310's legality checker rejects"), admitted as in [#313](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/313): [#280](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/280)'s own screen and emitter re-pinned to #312's final word. At the first `cleanup_gate` ADD (record 925,515) every data target already has its scalar endpoints (checked on the exact F₂ prefix); 440 helpers `a` have a single later scalar incidence `a −= b` with an unwritten donor, both at rank-22 frames whose span `E` is a nondegenerate 23-dimensional frame (477 multi-incidence dimension-3 candidates are not moved). With 40 replicas, 438 are moved (438·40 = 146·120 width-3 slots). The write commutes over the integers with every crossed gate; `a` and `b` advance to `E`, the ADD runs there and `a` retires at `E`. New-frame annihilators and cleared Gram determinants (mod 2¹²⁷ − 1), commutation, forward/inverse/roundtrip F₂ replays and an omitted-restoration control are checked. Local delta {1: +1314, 2: −876}; rank mass 398,057 → 397,619; endpoint residual 316,569 → 316,131.

**Admission of endpoints below the full frame.** #312's plan-driven `code/cohort-bank-review.cpp` now reads the candidate's `COHORT249-FINAL.json`: each helper's residual width is dim(endpoint) − dim(entrance) (#312's census is reproduced when nothing is restored), with the generic stock invariant (all slot coordinates fill the banks exactly). `stages/bank-tiling.json` carries the new census (438 at width 3, 1,762 at width 4, #312's kernel widths unchanged) and an exact integer tiling (ILP over patterns of ≤ 3 widths; 105,377 banks per stage) that the C++ verifies in full — collision-free tiling of all 3,026,400 slots, every bank a full 120-coordinate partition, per-pattern endpoint and omission/repetition controls, exact charts (4,703 new, ≤ 320 factors). Legality runs against the candidate's declared endpoints with the export's base frame table; 23,870 changed projector charts (3,221 retired endpoints, ≤ 342 factors). Literal stock 809,215 → 808,485 (normalized 161,697); finite coefficient 58,519,066,603,435,601 < 2⁸⁰; selector charge 571,949,825,600 < 2⁴⁰. Re-pinned: `code/admit_geometry.py`, `code/price.py` (word hash `a972abfe…`, 897,241 ADDs, 3,709,480 calls, mass 19,368,440, deficit 35,200, κ), `code/finish.py` (also cross-binding the restoration receipt and the pre-restoration word hash to #312's reorder output).
